newUnconfirmedDecisions.title: Verify cost-summary review findings against the current implementation

recommendation.rationale: The supplied finding is itself a bounded, read-only verification task: reproduce and deduplicate the nine bound native cost-summary observations (plus the earlier recreated-log cache and coverage-wording notes) against one isolated current-source checkout and classify confirmed defects versus false positives and historical-only issues. It matches the fix_now option's 'Run verification' and does not require live mutation, restarts, settings/route changes or reopening the accepted cost-summary job. Uncertainty: the nine items are unreproduced model observations at pinned SHAs, so some may not hold on current source; verification must preserve false-positive evidence and return only a bounded repair recommendation, with no fix implementation without a subsequent confirmed decision.

newUnconfirmedDecisions.title: Investigate the publication confirmation that stopped before enqueue

recommendation.rationale: The observation is bounded and directly verifiable: a native publish confirmation returned a generic uncertain capability result with zero grants/requests/effects, while explicit continuation succeeded. Running the isolated verification now can reproduce or candidly mark insufficient evidence, distinguish zero from uncertain effects, and confirm retry/reconciliation and idempotency behavior without live publication, approval bypass, or credential changes. The initial cause remains unknown, so this is verification rather than confirmation of a fixed defect.
